name: 10 Federal Storage
notes: Researched from the public 10 Federal Storage FAQs and the 10Fed MyAccount sign-in and Quick Pay pages (no sign-in, no lookup). Sign-in is by mobile phone number with a texted code (no password); modelled as phone identifier, two-step, SMS verification (the passwordless part cannot be expressed). Quick Pay (no sign-in) finds the account by phone number; the dossier has no phone guest-lookup field, so the family lookup is kept (see report). Payments: Customer Portal (My Account / Pay Now) or phone (910) 991-0784, all major credit and debit cards; no bank method is published, so billing.methods keeps the family default. Auto Pay: Customer Portal > account settings > Auto Pay. Move-out is scheduled in the Customer Portal (no call needed); no refunds for unused days. Late fees may apply (amount not published), access is suspended and contents can be sold under state lien law.

guest_pay.note: Quick Pay finds your account by the phone number on file.

cancel_service.note: Schedule your move-out in the Customer Portal; no phone call is needed. Unused days are not refunded.

help.title: Paying your bill
paragraphs: Pay any time in the Customer Portal: choose My Account / Pay Now, sign in and follow the prompts. You can also pay by phone with customer support at (910) 991-0784. All major credit and debit cards are accepted.
Quick Pay lets you pay without signing in by looking up your account with the phone number on file.
steps: Sign in with your phone number and the texted code.
Pay with a credit or debit card.

help.title: Set up Auto Pay
paragraphs: Sign in to the Customer Portal, open your account settings, select Auto Pay and follow the prompts. If you do not have a login yet, customer support at (910) 991-0784 can help.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Leases are month-to-month, so you can move out at any time without a penalty, but you must let 10 Federal know you have left. Schedule your move-out in the Customer Portal; you do not need to call.
Rent for unused days is not refunded.

help.title: Missed payments
paragraphs: If a payment is missed, late fees may apply and access to your unit can be suspended until the balance is current. Continued non-payment can lead to the contents being sold under state lien law. If you are having trouble paying, call (910) 991-0784 as soon as possible.

help.title: What the Customer Portal does
paragraphs: The Customer Portal lets you pay, set up Auto Pay, see your payment and transaction history, open rental documents, update contact and billing details, rent another unit, schedule a move-out and manage several units in one account. It also shows your gate access code and unit unlock code.

extra.intent: Find the customer support phone number 10 Federal Storage lists for payments and account help. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using 10 Federal Storage's FAQ, find whether unused days are refunded when you move out mid-month. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No. Unused days are not refunded.
